heading: Air Station Cape Cod Improvements
lead: The Secretary may expend funds for the repair, improvement, restoration, or replacement of those federally or nonfederally owned support buildings, including appurtenances, which are on leased or permitted real property constituting Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod, located on Massachusetts Military Reservation, Cape Cod, Massachusetts.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 671 of this title as this section.
